about: The first line on the free check for each ad (?from=, or utm_campaign when the ad sends utm_source + utm_campaign). It's the ad's own promise line (ops/film-scripts/ads.md, PR #96), so the page reads as the next step. Change both together. 'prefixes' covers a whole family of sources (share:<ref> is a link someone shared from their result). 'filter' shows under the first line for paid ads only (meta-... and ad-...); set it to "" to remove it.

lines.ad-grad: In two minutes, see where your applications are landing and the first move that changes it.
lines.ad-invisible: In two minutes, see how your best work reads to a hiring manager outside your team, and what to show first.
lines.ad-laidoff: In two minutes, get your map and the moves to make this week.
lines.meta-silence: In two minutes, see what a hiring manager concludes from your resume, and the one thing to fix today.
lines.meta-laidoff: The clock is running. In two minutes, see where your applications are getting stuck and what to do this week.
lines.meta-map: Your map draws itself as you answer. Two minutes, free.

prefixes.share:: A friend shared their scan with you. Take yours: two minutes, free.

filter: For software engineers who are ready to send a few honest notes, not 200 more applications.
